notes: OpenInterest is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Open Interest (OI) with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It exposes no additional minting or administrative controls and applies no transfer fees. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs with imdUSD at a 1.25% fee. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
